title: Horizon-Aware q10 Risk-Budget Comparison

governance.statement: 2024 evaluation outcomes were not used to select, tune, or modify the L2-EXP-12 formulation after pre-registration.

research_objective: Determine whether the conservatism of the validated static q10 solar-planning benchmark can be safely reduced by making relaxation horizon-aware and EMS-state-aware, rather than using the rejected hour-by-hour NN adaptive-q approach from L2-EXP-11.
core_question: Can we recover some of q10's diesel/curtailment efficiency while retaining its reliability advantage by allocating a bounded reliability-risk budget across the full 24h horizon?

Arm_A.name: Candidate F Point Control
Arm_A.description: Existing Candidate F / Stage8.1 point forecast control. Unmodified.

Arm_B.name: Static q10 Safety Benchmark
Arm_B.description: Existing validated static q10 planning benchmark. Unmodified.

Arm_C.name: Fixed Modest q Relaxation
Arm_C.description: Fixed daytime q = 0.15 (night q = 0.10). Evaluates constant non-state-aware relaxation.
Arm_C.role: Research diagnostic for baseline relaxation cost/reliability trade-off

Arm_D.name: SOC-Aware q Relaxation
Arm_D.description: q relaxes up to 0.20 only when initial battery SOC is comfortably above reserve threshold, with afternoon horizon decay.

Arm_E.name: Horizon Risk-Budget q Relaxation
Arm_E.description: Allocates a bounded cumulative optimism energy budget (B_max = 15,000 Wh) across the 24h horizon, dynamically tightening q toward q10 during high-spread midday hours and when reserve margins decline.
Arm_E.role: Primary research arm — horizon-level reliability-risk budgeting
Arm_E.budget_units: Watt-hours of cumulative potential solar over-optimism energy relative to q10
Arm_E.formula: E_opt,t = min( (B_rem / N_rem) * rho_soc, ((q_max - q_min)/0.40) * delta_p_t ); q_t = q_min + 0.40 * (E_opt,t / delta_p_t)

Arm_F.name: Perfect Foresight Diagnostic
Arm_F.description: Dispatches with actual realized solar power. Upper bound on achievable efficiency.

acceptance_gates.G1_soc_safety: Zero SOC floor violations (< 20%) and zero SOC ceiling violations (> 95%) across all origins
acceptance_gates.G2_accounting: Exact energy balance, exact non-anticipativity, zero silent clipping
acceptance_gates.G3_reliability: Realized unmet critical load <= Arm B * 1.10 (71,529.6 Wh across 123 NORMAL origins)
acceptance_gates.G4_reliability_consistency: Critical reliability statistically consistent with static q10
acceptance_gates.G5_efficiency: Statistically significant reduction in diesel fuel and/or solar curtailment vs Arm B
